question: Is purity cognizer-dharma or object-dharma?
premises: this indeed is cognizer-dharma, from unity/non-unity experience of consciousness
inference: Purity is either cognizer-side experience or measure-bound object-side — both relational.
plain_english: This indeed is cognizer-dharma, from experiencing consciousness as one and not-one — or if even object-nature, bound to measure-dependence.
